specials_designed.1 steal: WARRANT: inspect target's FULL hand privately (incl. their specials), take ONE item of your choice — specials stealable (ruling 1, ratified). Respect taker's caps.
specials_designed.2 see-all: DRAGNET: privately see EVERY player's REGULAR items only — specials NOT shown (ratified: kills the DRAGNET->WARRANT seek-and-steal pipeline; WARRANT = narrow+deep, DRAGNET = wide+shallow, each special keeps a monopoly)
specials_designed.3 puppet: HANDLER v2 (user redesign 2026-07-11, replaces v1 'ridden' model): SILENT REDIRECT. Seize = ONE atomic move during any other player's decision/aiming phase: pick target X from the SHOOTER's legal targets at seize time, confirm, HANDLER consumed. Shooter gets ZERO notice — no banner, no locked SHOOT, picks + confirms their own target normally. Whatever shot ends that turn (deliberate OR timeout auto-self-shot, ruling v2-1) resolves at X instead. Wire/table/record all read 'shooter shot X'. Shooter learns ONLY from the damage mismatch; same-target pick = perfect crime, shooter never knows; no proof possible. v2-2: X must be legal for the shooter (TERMS respected — 'as if the handler's mind controlled their hands'); X may be the shooter themself (forced self-shot) or the seizer. v2-3: first seize locks; later seize attempts get PRIVATE error 'trigger already held' (leaks only to conspirator #2). Bot aiming window (5s) kept, shot still fires exactly AT deadline when seized (early fire would leak — secrecy law). Kill credit/extra turn/poison follow wire truth (the shooter). Archive (recorder) logs the seize + real target; wire never does.

resolution_session.rig_lessons: THIS MACHINE CAN GO FULLY rAF-DEAD (screen locked/idle): visible+focused tab, 0 rAF ticks in 800ms real — NO live-rAF run is possible; foregrounding via user32 does not help. Manual g.loop.step pumps the Phaser clock but NOT tweens (Phaser captured the real perf.now/Date.now at load — live monkey-patching is TOO LATE; a 180ms tween sat at progress 0.00 through 2100 pumped frames; one tween showed duration 8.4e14ms). THE cure is livepump.html (committed, static/game/): virtualizes rAF+performance.now+Date.now BEFORE phaser loads (capture.html's trick), then document.open-swallows the real index.html — the LIVE ws game then plays under window.__pump.start()/stop() at ~4x real speed, film-grabbable via canvas.toDataURL to the devcap sink. Older lessons still hold: never g.loop.sleep() during the opening drain; lobby DEPART id = 'startbtn'; join ids name/lastinit/enterbtn; wedged-CDP tab -> fresh tab; band countdown display reads the virtualized Date.now and races — cosmetic.
